heading: Upward Soccer
intro: A fun, low-pressure season where every player feels valued, gets real playing time, and grows on and off the field.

who.title: Boys and girls, age 5 through 12th grade
who.text: Players must turn 5 by March 15, 2027. Depending on registration numbers, we offer boys divisions, girls divisions, and co-ed high school divisions.

who.title: Placed by age
who.text: Teams are set by age using a July 31 cutoff. Use the [age group finder](#ages) to see your child's division.

who.title: All skill levels
who.text: Brand new to soccer, years of experience, or ready to enjoy the game again after burning out. Everyone is welcome here.

schedule.title: Practice
schedule.text: One 60-minute evening practice a week on Monday, Tuesday, or Thursday.

schedule.title: Kindergarten (U6)
schedule.text: No weeknight practice. Instead, a 15-minute mini practice right before each Saturday game.

schedule.title: Games
schedule.text: One game every Saturday, morning or afternoon depending on division.

registrationNotes: Registration is complete once full payment is received. Register your child in the grade they're in right now.
bring: Shin guards (required for all ages) and cleats (optional for kindergarten).

dates.label: Team placements sent
dates.note: Team, coach, practice night, and season schedule arrive by text and email.

dates.label: First week of practices
dates.note: Weather permitting. Watch for your team's night and time.

dates.label: Outdoor games
dates.note: Saturdays. No games on Easter weekend.

datesNote: There are no makeup games during the season.
